note: Per the brief, flagged irregularities and unverified items do not block the merge. Each is published here with its source so it can be reviewed and changed after the site is live.

flags.title: The five submitted short-link codes are 9 characters and do not match the 10-character ASIN format.
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59 and B0f3GKalj each contain 9 characters. Amazon describes an ASIN as 10 characters (SRC-04). The code is not used as an ASIN anywhere in this site. Each short link resolved to a different /dp/ page with a different ASIN (see link-validation).
flags.action: Confirm which listing each short link was meant to point to. Record the intended ASIN and the date and source of that confirmation in data/products.json (intent fields).

flags.title: No observed redirect URL carries an Associates tag. Tracking attribution to shopnow047c-20 is unconfirmed.
flags.detail: None of the five redirect URLs contains a tag= parameter. Program Policies Participation Requirements §2(a)–(b) require the Associates ID or tag as a URL parameter on each Special Link. The compliance status of the supplied short links is unresolved (see FLG-003 in the brief). This flag does not state that the links are invalid. Until the test passes, every Amazon link on this site (calls to action and source links) is the untagged supplied or observed URL. This interim state is recorded here for review. Tagged candidate links stay out of the site behind the build gate in data/products.json.
flags.action: Run the one-link test in Associates Central for each product (flag F-22) and record the outcome in the link-validation table.

flags.title: Intended ASIN is blank for all five products.
flags.detail: No intended ASIN was supplied in the brief. The observed ASINs come from the redirect targets only. They are shown in the observed fields and are not copied into the intent fields. The Amazon-staff source for the ASIN definition is a forum reply, not a help page (SRC-04).
flags.action: Confirm the intended ASIN per product. Note the confirmation date and source.

flags.title: Possible duplicate listing for P-01 (CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket).
flags.detail: The 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' section on the P-01 listing shows a product titled 'Chefman 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer' with ASIN B0B7C327LK. That is a different ASIN from the observed B0CDY277D3. Whether the two are the same product, a variant, or a different product was not verified.
flags.action: Confirm which ASIN is intended for P-01.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings are withheld from the site.
flags.detail: Prices and ratings were visible on the observed listings but are not recorded or shown. Program Policies Participation Requirements §2(b) limits price display to links Amazon serves or to PA-API or Creators API data. Section 6(t) limits display of customer reviews and star ratings in the same way. Product pricing analysis and review analysis therefore need API access first.
flags.action: Decide whether to apply for PA-API / Creators API access (suggestion S-09).

flags.title: Commission rates are blank.
flags.detail: The rate schedule (Appendix) links to a page that requires Amazon sign-in. The rates could not be read, so none are shown. The commission-income rules (session length, purchase window, exclusions) were verified from SRC-02 and are described on the Commission Potential section of the executive summary.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central, copy the Home & Kitchen rate into data/products.json, and record the date and source.

flags.title: Disclosure placement and wording need human review.
flags.detail: The statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' is shown under the masthead on every page and in the footer, as Operating Agreement §5 requires. The FTC guidance says to place a disclosure so it is 'hard to miss', and warns that disclosures are likely to be missed on an About Me or profile page, at the end of posts, or anywhere that requires a click to see more (SRC-05). This site places it under the masthead. A reviewer should confirm that placement, and confirm that the site is in the Associates program for the URL it runs on.
flags.action: Review the disclosure strip and the disclosure page against SRC-01 and SRC-05.

flags.title: No hands-on testing was done. The site must not imply that it did.
flags.detail: The site contains no test results, measurements, or personal-use claims. Guides are written from listing text, manufacturer claims (labelled as such), and public standards. FTC guidance says an endorser can't talk about a product they haven't tried (SRC-05), and the Endorsement Guides apply to the advertiser's claims (SRC-06).
flags.action: Keep the no-testing statement on the disclosure page. Do not add test claims unless testing is done and documented.

flags.title: IDs in the brief refer to a source register that is not in this repository.
flags.detail: The brief cites S01, S02, S07, S24, FLG-003, SG-27 to SG-30, a 'Priority 4' and 'Priority 5' structure, and an 'Operating Agreement'. None of these exist as files in the repository, which contained only README.md. They could not be mapped to sources. The site uses its own IDs (SRC-nn, F-nn, Q-nn, S-nn) and does not claim to match the brief's IDs.
flags.action: Provide the source register file, or confirm that the IDs above are placeholders.

flags.title: The campaign ledger is empty. No clicks, sessions, or orders are recorded.
flags.detail: No authorized first-party reports (Associates Central reports or the site's own analytics) were available. The ledger is set up with the required fields and no rows. No conversion score, revenue forecast, or trend claim is made.
flags.action: Add rows only from authorized first-party reports, with the source and date.

flags.title: Real analytics and the self-hosted endpoint are not live.
flags.detail: GitHub Pages serves static files only, so the collector in analytics/ cannot run there. The site's tracking script sends nothing until an endpoint is configured. Five events are defined and tested. Real counts need the collector hosted somewhere (suggestion S-03) and the endpoint set in docs/assets/config.js.
flags.action: Choose a hosting option for the collector (S-03), then set the endpoint.

flags.title: The five events to record were not defined in the brief.
flags.detail: The brief asks for 'the five defined events' without listing them. The site uses a proposed set: page_view, outbound_click, guide_read, disclosure_expand, feed_click. Each is defined on the analytics page and in analytics/events.json.
flags.action: Confirm the event set or send the definitions you intended.

flags.title: Google Search Console is not connected. Verification needs your Google account.
flags.detail: Search Console property verification requires a signed-in Google account, which this session does not have. The sitemap and robots.txt are ready to submit once it is connected.
flags.action: Verify the site in Search Console and submit sitemap.xml (see suggestion S-11).

flags.title: No author identity was supplied. Bylines read 'Editorial team'.
flags.detail: No person, credentials, or biography were provided, so none are shown. Bylines are not attributed to any named person.
flags.action: Choose the byline approach (S-06).

flags.title: The site name is a working name. No trademark check was run.
flags.detail: The brief did not give a brand name. The site uses the working name 'The Countertop Guide'. No trademark search was done. Program Policies Participation Requirements §1(g) bars Amazon trademarks in the domain or tag, and this name does not use one.
flags.action: Confirm or replace the brand name (S-04). Run a trademark check before publishing under a final name.

flags.title: No product photos are used.
flags.detail: Product photos on Amazon listings were not reused. The rights to reuse listing images were not verified, and Participation Requirements §6(a) and §6(d) restrict changes to, and use of, Program Content. The site uses typographic covers instead.
flags.action: Decide on imagery (S-07).

flags.title: The Associates application may not list this site's URL.
flags.detail: Participation Requirements §1 says the site must be publicly available at the address given in the application. The GitHub Pages address is not confirmed as the one in the application.
flags.action: Check the site URL in Associates Central and update it if needed.

flags.title: Operator identity and privacy policy are not supplied.
flags.detail: Participation Requirements §3(e) requires accurate disclosure of cookies and tracking, and the visitor's opt-out choices where the law requires them. The site sets no cookies and sends no data unless the analytics endpoint is configured. The operator's legal identity, contact address, and privacy policy text were not supplied, so the privacy page is a draft.
flags.action: Supply the operator details and review the privacy page.

flags.title: Manufacturer claims in listing titles are not verified.
flags.detail: Claims such as '±0.5℉ Accuracy', 'NIST&NSF Certified', 'IP67 Waterproof', '450°F Hi-Fry Option', and '1000°F Heat Safe' come from listing titles. They are labelled on the site as manufacturer claims. They were not independently checked against any certification body.
flags.action: Verify any claim before it is used as a fact. Certification numbers would come from the certifying body.

flags.title: The repository had no license, CI, or coordination file.
flags.detail: On review, the repository contained README.md (its only content was '# WinA'). There was no LICENSE, no CI workflow, and no COORDINATION.md. COORDINATION.md was created in this session.
flags.action: Choose a license (not chosen in this session).

flags.title: Reviews and ratings are not displayed, which affects the page design.
flags.detail: Because of Participation Requirements §6(t), star ratings and review counts are not shown. The product cards show listing claims and categories only.
flags.action: Revisit once PA-API access is decided (S-09).

flags.title: The one-link-per-product test in Associates Central has not been run.
flags.detail: The brief asks for one test link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow, with the destination and tracking report checked before scaling. That needs your Associates login. The test must be a click-through check, not a purchase, because Participation Requirements §6(u) bars purchases through your own links.
flags.action: Run the five-link test (documented on link-validation). Record the outcome per product.

flags.title: The FTC Disclosures 101 brochure is dated November 2019.
flags.detail: The FTC page shows November 2019. The Endorsement Guides were revised in 2023 (SRC-06). The site cites both. A reviewer should check the current FTC guidance before relying on the wording.
flags.action: Review the FTC pages before each publication cycle.

flags.title: Listing and redirect observations are a single-session snapshot.
flags.detail: The redirect targets and listing titles were read once on 2026-11-20 through a fetch tool, not a browser session. Redirects and titles can change by region and over time.
flags.action: Re-observe before each publication cycle.
